name: cached-video-thumbnail
description: Package-specific skills for the cached_video_thumbnail Flutter plugin: feed integration and performance tuning, error and cache diagnosis, hermetic testing without native code, and migration from the video_thumbnail package family.

interface.shortDescription: Skills for the cached_video_thumbnail Flutter plugin
interface.longDescription: Adds package-specific expertise for the cached_video_thumbnail Flutter plugin to your agent: correct feed integration with physical-pixel specs and priority scheduling, diagnosis of thumbnail errors and cache behavior, hermetic test setup with a fake extractor, and guided migration from video_thumbnail, flutter_video_thumbnail_plus, get_thumbnail_video, and fc_native_video_thumbnail.
